description:
HTC AT‑527 rechargeable hair trimmer is a budget-friendly cordless beard trimmer for men and women who want clean lines and quick grooming at home. Get up to 45 minutes of cordless runtime to shape your beard, trim mustache edges, and tidy hair and body grooming without being stuck to a socket. The stainless-steel blades cut smoothly for a neat finish, while the ergonomic grip keeps control steady around jawlines, sideburns, and neckline.

With a trimming range of 0.5mm to 12mm (with comb), you can maintain stubble, keep a short beard even, or do quick touch-ups before office, college, or travel. The blades are detachable and washable for easy cleanup (the trimmer body is not waterproof). If you want a simple, reliable trimmer that keeps you looking sharp without salon visits, AT‑527 is the easy pick.
